input.selectedRowRule: Exactly one JSONL object with pdbId equal to 1BJ1; raw-line hash excludes the line-feed terminator.

positiveSourceFacts.fact: The complete retained polymer inventory has one Fab-fragment light-chain entity, one Fab-fragment heavy-chain entity and one VEGFA-annotated entity.
Fresh Europe PMC/PubMed and Crossref records match DOI 10.1016/s0969-2126(98)00116-6 and identify the publication as a VEGF complex with a humanized neutralizing-antibody Fab fragment.

auditInference.statement: The numbered-heavy lead occurs in a deposition and publication explicitly described as a Fab complex. Heavy-domain recognition alone therefore does not establish that this is a VHH candidate.
notEstablished: Exact experimentally expressed construct identity and processing from primary preparation Methods.
A source-reviewed direct GPCR-VHH pair meeting the frozen eligibility definition.
A formal whole-entry exclusion or proof of absence of every possible relevant binder.
auditInference.annotationCaveat: The antibody source-organism metadata report Mus musculus while the publication title describes a humanized antibody. Both are preserved; no unreported humanization, construct-origin or processing history is inferred.

continuation: Retain as a conventional-Fab-context triage lead. Do not promote heavy-domain recognition to VHH eligibility or silently mark a formal exclusion. If formal disposition is needed, obtain permitted primary preparation/construct and deposition evidence; do not repeat the same failed routes without new access evidence.
scopeLimit: This review concerns only 1BJ1 and its three deposited polymer entities. It supplies neither an absence proof nor any bound for the phrase-only remainder or the whole census.
